text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — proposing a deployment choreography for next Thu to align US/EU/APAC with minimal overlap. Please review windows and call out conflicts.

Alex Chen: High level goals: avoid midnight hits in any region, keep canary in EU first (low traffic), then US, then APAC, and ensure cache warmup and model shards are primed before traffic.

Alex Chen: Proposed windows (UTC + locals):
```
EU canary: 08:00-09:00 UTC (09:00 CET)
US canary: 14:00-15:00 UTC (07:00 PDT / 10:00 EDT)
APAC ramp: 22:00-23:30 UTC (07:00 SGT next day)
Cutoff for cherry-picks: 06:00 UTC on deploy day
Branch freeze start: 06:30 UTC
Smoke/rollout end goal: 00:00 UTC+1 after APAC ramp
```

Priya Rao: Quick Q — what's the canary traffic split and metrics? :eyes:

Alex Chen: Plan: EU canary 2% for 15m -> 10% for 15m -> 50% for 30m if all green. US similar but start at 5%. APAC skip 2% (low baseline) and jump to 25% after US steady state. Metrics: latency p95, error rate, token-per-second delta, model-quality regression alerts from evals.

Samir Patel: Will the rollout script perform automatic ramp only if alerts are clear? Or manual thumbs?

Alex Chen: Automated ramp with manual gate at the 50% step for EU/US. We keep manual gate for APAC. Ops will have abort hook.

Lee Wong: FYI we need DB migration flag flip — must be run in maintenance window before APAC ramp. Suggest 21:30 UTC to run migration and warm caches at 21:45 UTC.

Maria Gomez: Can we move APAC ramp earlier by 1h to avoid local 8am traffic spike? That's when partner jobs run.

Alex Chen: We can shift APAC to 21:00-22:30 UTC, starting warmup at 20:30 UTC. That still keeps US in business hours.

Priya Rao: Changelog bump reminder: someone needs to add the v2.2.1 notes + highlight runtime kernel change and new quantization defaults. I can take that if someone drops PR. Also tag docs.

Samir Patel: I'll open the release PR and tag @Priya. Branch pin: release/v2.2 will be the branch we bump. No merges after cutoff.

Alex Chen: Can we get a quick CR on the rollout script? It's in infra/deploy/rollout.py — small change to add the APAC warmup flag.

Samir Patel: On it, pinging for review.

Lee Wong: @deploy-bot can you schedule the warmup job for 20:30 UTC once PR is merged?

deploy-bot: Scheduled job "warmup-cache" for 20:30 UTC on deploy day. Job id: warmup-1825-01. :white_check_mark:

Maria Gomez: One more: notify support and post pre-deploy note in #support 2 hours before APAC ramp. I'll draft.

Alex Chen: Awesome. Final checklist before deploy day:
- [ ] Release PR open and changelog added (Samir + Priya)
- [ ] Branch freeze enforced at cutoff (release lead)
- [ ] Rollout script tested and CR'd (Samir)
- [ ] DB migration scheduled at 21:30 UTC (Lee)
- [ ] Warmup job scheduled (deploy-bot confirms)
- [ ] Support and oncall notified (Maria)

Priya Rao: I'll also add a short eval prompt set for the first 50k tokens to catch regressions early.

Alex Chen: Thanks — if no objections I'll lock in the shifted times by EOD and add to the release calendar. :ship: 

Maria Gomez: LGTM from me.

Samir Patel: LGTM, prepping PR.

Lee Wong: 👍 I'll handle migration.

deploy-bot: Reminder: next deployment window created: "multi-region-choreo-1825" — owners: Alex Chen, Samir Patel.

Alex Chen: Perfect. If anyone sees a blocker, reply here or DM. Otherwise I'll lock schedule at 18:00 UTC today.
